synopsis: ACAS X encounter models draw on long-standing work, including a MIT Lincoln Laboratory aircraft encounter model built from nine months of radar recordings [f1433, f15750]. March 2022 RTCA SC-147 minutes recorded that European encounter-model results suggested ACAS Xa induced more near mid-air collisions than TCAS, while MIT Lincoln Laboratory did not see the same disparity [f1436]. This disagreement raised questions about encounter or scenario model representativeness, and sensor noise had not been assessed [f1968]. The corpus treats the divergence as a warning against relying on a single simulation toolchain [f1969].
